verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes an extensive REST API reference (create/charge/introspect tokens, wallet balance, source IPs, organization seller-agent creation) plus an MCP server exposing agent-native tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token), all documented at docs.skyfire.xyz — a clear documented public API surface for AI-native agents. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s at standard paths) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
